payload.text: Under E-001, Mira states: I saw Fictional Rowan hand a blue token to Fictional Ellis at the desk. Under E-002, Tavi states: I saw Fictional Ellis standing at the desk. Fictional Rowan left with the blue token still in their hand. I did not see a handover. Both are permitted attributed accounts; attribution does not establish the event. The Crown carries the burden beyond a reasonable doubt on the listed condition. The supplied record does not resolve whether the handover occurred.

The Defence agrees with the Crown's concession: E-001 and E-002 are attributed accounts whose status remains disputed. Mira describes a handover; Tavi states they saw Fictional Ellis at the desk but did not see a handover, with Fictional Rowan leaving with the blue token still in hand. Attribution does not establish the listed blue-token receipt condition, and the supplied record does not resolve it. The burden rests with the Crown beyond a reasonable doubt on the fictional condition, and that burden is not met on this record.
